title: Room Stability Score Across Seasons
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk
| stats stdev(temp_c) as temp_sd, stdev(humidity_pct) as humidity_sd by room season
| eval stability_score=round(100-(temp_sd*5)-(humidity_sd*1.5),1)
| sort - stability_score
description: Scores which rooms stay most stable across seasons and which ones swing wildly.
value: Stability is a good shorthand for comfort, condensation control, and how predictable a room feels to live in.
implementation: Log seasonal mould-risk readings with room and season tags; derive a simple stability score from temperature and humidity variance.
visualization: Table of rooms and seasons ranked by stability score.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which rooms stay nicely steady through the seasons and which ones swing around the most.
